title: Harness test tuning command
summary: The standalone tune command MUST audit the harness test suite outside workflow runs, run benchmark, comparison, and judgment passes in parallel, and write validated records under runtime/tune-harness/ without editing source files.
instructions: The command MUST run only in self-development because installed Pancreator payloads contain no harness tests.
The command MUST NOT edit tests or other tracked source files.
The command MUST prepare one session, inventory current tests, and start benchmark, retained-set comparison, and handbook judgment in one top-level parallel fan-out.
The judgment pass MUST read the handbook and prepared inventory. It MUST NOT read benchmark or comparison output.
The judgment pass MUST record its exact handbook, inventory, and similarity inputs in the session provenance file.
Each tune record MUST name the harness version, Git commit, workspace fingerprint, retained set, and measured file costs.
The first run MAY accept --baseline <ref> and derive the retained set from that revision through a temporary detached worktree.
A baseline revision runs its install, build, and test scripts. The operator MUST trust that revision before use.
Tune state MUST live under runtime/tune-harness/ so pan archive does not move it.
Finalization MUST validate completeness, overlap, references, and record shape before it atomically writes the immutable record, ranked report, and latest pointer.
No deterministic check MAY judge whether a verdict is correct. Validators check structure and orchestration facts only.
A DEMOTE recommendation MUST name a documented lane destination or a cheaper direct form.

guidance_sources.read_trigger: Read this guidance before you assign tune verdicts or validate tune records.
